_readme: Themed puzzles. This file is the ONLY place a theme is authored — the
generator merges it over the generated set, so an editor never touches code.
A theme claims a base word. Claimed bases are generated FIRST and win their
anagram slot, so a claim reliably lands. Clues written here override the
auto-generated Webster ones; anything not overridden falls back, so a theme
Clue rules, enforced by the build (it prints what it rejected and why):
- never contain the answer or a 4+ character stem of it
- no two rows in a puzzle may pose the same question
VOICE NOTE: these are a first draft written to prove the pipeline and give
an editor something to react to. They should be revised by someone with

VOICE NOTE: specific over general. A clue should name a thing you can picture — a red cup, a thick envelope, the chair by the window — not gesture at a mood. Generic warmth reads as an outsider being careful.

themes.name: The Cookout
themes.blurb: Somebody's cousin on the grill, matching shirts nobody agreed to, and a plate made for you before you asked.

themes.name: The Nineties
themes.blurb: R&B, hip-hop, new jack and neo-soul — the decade as it came out of the speakers.

themes.name: The Shop
themes.blurb: Two rooms with the same rules: you wait your turn, you tip, and you do not touch the chair.

themes.name: Sunday Dinner
themes.blurb: The pot that went on before church, the plate fixed for somebody who could not come, and the seat nobody else sits in.

themes.name: The Card Table
themes.blurb: Four chairs, a bid you have to make, and a score kept on the back of an envelope.

themes.name: Sunday Service
themes.blurb: The organ, the fan, the mothers in white, and the Friday fish fry that pays for the roof.

themes.name: The Floor
themes.blurb: Chicago steppin' and DC go-go — two cities that never stopped dancing to a live band.

themes.name: The Nineteenth
themes.blurb: Two and a half years late to Galveston, and observed ever since in red — the drink, the cake, the whole table.

themes.name: Barbecue
themes.blurb: Whole hog in the Carolinas, brisket in Central Texas, rib tips and hot links on the South Side — three traditions, one fire, and Black pitmasters in all three.

themes.name: Which Island
themes.blurb: A sampler, not a country — Jamaica, Trinidad, Barbados, Haiti and more, and the first question anybody asks is which one.
